# Running log

## Goal

Run a 10k under 50 minutes by the spring race.

## Weekly plan

- Tuesday: intervals, 6 x 800 m at 5k pace with 400 m jog recovery.
- Thursday: 30-minute tempo run at a comfortably hard pace.
- Sunday: long slow run, adding 1 km per week up to 14 km.

## Injuries

Shin splints came back in week 4 after increasing mileage too quickly. The fix
was the 10% rule (never add more than 10% weekly distance), new shoes after
600 km, and calf raises every evening.

## Results

- March: 10k in 53:40.
- May: 10k in 51:05.
